about_the_game:
From the cautious excitement of exploration with a friend, to the musical and music-adjacent equivalents of panic attacks, existential crises, dissociative episodes and ego death - this soundtrack features 74 tracks totalling in 4 hours of music from FriendShapes, composed by RaddyRecords!

NOTE: This OST does not feature the two tracks used for the overworld by Mystic Sound of Meditation's: "Lamp's Tale" and "Fear (Trancendending)" - these can be easily found on their Youtube channel!
